synthetic_fixture_note: The station, test outcomes, participant roles, and 100-unit escrow are synthetic demonstration fixtures. The fetched Open-Meteo precipitation record and DFRobot calibration example are real public source content, but they do not attest that a physical station was built, tested, repaired, or calibrated. Ledger units are not GEN, a token, payment, custody, or a commitment to real work.

terms.brief: Build and deliver a maintainable solar-powered water testing station for rural clinics, meeting the agreed safety and performance criteria.

criteria.description: The enclosure withstands the documented outdoor rain exposure without water reaching electronics.
The conductivity sensor readings at 25°C stay within ±2% of the 1,413 µS/cm calibration standard.

terms.remedy_rule: release accepted or remedied criterion allocations; refund each unresolved defect's full criterion allocation

submission_v1.summary: Synthetic demonstration fixture, not a physical station: version 1 lacks a sealed enclosure. The fixture records simulated ingress during the public Lagos-area 59.1 mm rain day on 2026-07-10. It also records a simulated conductivity reading of 1,520 µS/cm against the frozen 1,413 µS/cm standard at 25°C, outside the ±2% tolerance.

weatherproofing_state.description: The enclosure withstands the documented outdoor rain exposure without water reaching electronics.

calibration_state.description: The conductivity sensor readings at 25°C stay within ±2% of the 1,413 µS/cm calibration standard.

demo_fixture.initial_submission_summary: Synthetic demonstration fixture, not a physical station: version 1 lacks a sealed enclosure. claims.allegation: In this synthetic fixture, water reached the electronics during outdoor rain exposure corresponding to the public 2026-07-10 Lagos-area precipitation record.
In this synthetic fixture, the 1,520 µS/cm reading exceeds the frozen ±2% tolerance around the 1,413 µS/cm calibration standard at 25°C.

demo_fixture.repair_submission_summary: Synthetic demonstration fixture, not a physical repair: version 2 replaces the enclosure gasket and seals the cable gland; the fixture records a successful repeat ingress check. The conductivity reading remains 1,520 µS/cm against the 1,413 µS/cm standard, with no new calibration record, so that criterion remains unresolved.
demo_fixture.actual_work_status: No physical station, test, repair, or calibration was performed.

recovery_notes: The first harness attempted to read deliverable version 2 before it existed; this caused a read-only gen_call error after the initial judgment transaction had already finalized.
A corrected read-only snapshot was taken without redeploying or repeating the judgment.
The initial judgment transaction must be evaluated using its ACCEPTED poll status, finalized receipt, leader execution, majority result, votes, and resulting public state.
get_state_note: The contract exposes get_terms, get_submission(version), get_claim(criterion_id), get_criterion_state(criterion_id), and get_accounting; it has no get_state(). The complete current-readable view snapshot is public_view_readback.

readback_unavailable_views.reason: Version 2 was not submitted because the initial judgment transaction finalized as UNDETERMINED.
No claim was persisted; both get_criterion_state views return claim=null.

transaction_status_interpretation.state_effect: No defect claims were stored. Phase remains AWAITING_CLAIMS; both criteria remain UNREVIEWED; all 100 demo units remain escrowed.

expected_failure_not_run_reason: The requested replay-abuse transaction was not sent because the initial judgment did not reach an accepted consensus result.

repository_publication.anonymous_project_url_checks: Not applicable; repository remains private after the incomplete demo.

actual_run_types.static_review: Source-level mechanism comparisons and bounded-input/accounting review completed; local live-demo harness Python 3.14 syntax compile passed.
actual_run_types.mocked_direct_tests: Previously recorded 16 parameter-expanded direct checks passed with mocked web/model responses; not rerun after the explicit example/test-fixture tolerance wording change.
actual_run_types.live_network: StudioNet chain 61999: deployment, supplier acceptance, and initial deliverable each finalized with leader SUCCESS. One initial judgment transaction ended in UNDETERMINED/MAJORITY_DISAGREE; public readback confirms no judgment state change. No retry or later write was sent.
actual_run_types.evidence_mode: Two public sources passed anonymous HTTP/UTF-8/5,000-byte curl preflight. The station/test facts are synthetic; external sources do not attest to a physical station or its measurements.

technical_readiness.evidence: The distinct repair/refund lifecycle was not completed because the initial defect judgment finalized with UNDETERMINED status and MAJORITY_DISAGREE votes; readback remains AWAITING_CLAIMS.

distinctiveness.evidence: Source comparison distinguishes persistent criterion claims across supplier versions from one-shot status/payout projects; the recorded direct suite covers repair persistence and per-criterion settlement.

evidence_readiness.evidence: Open-Meteo JSON passed at 286 bytes and DFRobot source at 1,876 bytes, both anonymous HTTP 200 and valid UTF-8; validator consensus did not accept the live judgment and no source snapshot was committed to contract state.

top_blockers.issue: The fetch wrapper returns availability and text but does not persist an auditable per-source HTTP/byte record, so the validator disagreement cannot be attributed to a particular fetch result from state alone.
The independently executed defect assessment did not converge to an accepted result for the synthetic fixture and selected public sources.
Claims are persisted only after an accepted judgment, leaving the deployment at AWAITING_CLAIMS with no repair state to demonstrate.

unverified: Whether StudioNet validators can fetch these sources consistently during consensus.
Whether the selected public references provide sufficient evidence for an accepted two-defect judgment.
The repair/refund transition, one-time settlement replay protection, and their full post-settlement readback on StudioNet.
Any physical station, ingress test, calibration measurement, or real payment/custody.
Anonymous HTTP 200 for the project repository’s future public evidence pages; it remains private.
self_review.distinct_reusable_contribution: A versioned defect state machine that carries only established criterion defects through bounded supplier repairs, then releases or refunds each fixed allocation once.
